{
  "score": 7,
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh",
      "category": "hot-path I/O",
      "severity": "medium",
      "line": 2479,
      "message": "Every cycle iteration now performs two `locked_state_update` calls (one added at iter-start, one pre-existing at iter-end), each involving flock acquisition, a `jq empty` validation subprocess, a jq transform subprocess, mktemp, and an atomic rename — doubling per-iteration blocking I/O on the cycle hot path.",
      "quote": "_cycle_state_write_iter_start \"$state_file\" \"$cycle_id\" \"$iter\" \\\n            || warn \"cycle-orchestrator: failed to write iter-start state for cycle=$cycle_id iter=$iter (a resume may start at the wrong iteration)\"",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh",
      "category": "hot-path subprocess per stage",
      "severity": "low",
      "line": 3544,
      "message": "On the resume startup path, every complete dispatch unit triggers `get_state_field` inside a subshell `$(...)`, spawning a `jq empty` validation subprocess plus a `jq` extraction subprocess per stage — O(N) subprocess pairs where N is the number of completed stages.",
      "quote": "_du_cyc_status=\"$(get_state_field \"$state_file\" \\\n                            \".stage_statuses[\\\"$_safe_cyc_id\\\"]\" '' 2>/dev/null || true)\"",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh",
      "category": "unnecessary allocations",
      "severity": "low",
      "line": 1466,
      "message": "In `_cycle_iter_dispatch` on the first resumed iteration, each complete cycle member spawns four separate `jq` subprocesses (status read, verdict read, blob-entry construction, blob merge) that could be collapsed into a single `jq` call reading all three fields at once.",
      "quote": "_cmbr_status=\"$(jq -r --arg s \"$s\" '.stage_statuses[$s] // \"pending\"' \\\n                \"$state_file\" 2>/dev/null || echo \"pending\")\"",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    }
  ]
}
